note: Corps of Engineers campground on a hillside above a cove of Rough River Lake at Falls of Rough, run by the concessionaire Bright Sky Campgrounds. The E-loop sites along the top of the bank overlook the cove; the hilltop A loop is away from the lake. Two boat ramps, fishing pier, courtesy dock, mountain bike trail, disc golf and a playground. --Claude

flags: WATERFRONT DOWN (lakefront -> lakeview): rec.gov tags 49, 51, 52, 53, 56, 60 'Lakefront' and Campspot tags its Deluxe types (C31-C35, E49-E60) 'Waterfront Site', but USGS 3DEP lidar puts every RV pad well above the summer pool (Rough River 495 ft = 150.9 m): site 49 (37.57249,-86.49287) is at 159.6 m and reaches 150.9 m at ~23 m (bank ~38%); site 52 (37.57207,-86.49295) 157.7 m, pool ~11 m out (~60% slope); site 60 (37.57163,-86.49344) 158.2 m, pool ~50 m out; C35 (37.57269,-86.49300) 162.5 m, pool ~40 m. Pads 7-11 m above the water over a steep wooded bank fail the kayak test (Tailwater/Narrows precedent). Esri imagery shows E49-E52 at the top of the bank with a thin tree line and the lake visible, so lakeview stands. The tent-only sites 61-64 (also 'Lakefront') don't count. Replacement evidence: 'rec.gov site points + USGS 3DEP 2026-11-23: E-loop RV pads 49-60 sit 157-162 m, 7-11 m above summer pool (150.9 m) at 11-50 m over a steep wooded bank; lake visible through a thin tree line from 49-53 -> lakeview; earlier lakefront rested on the rec.gov tag.'

PHONE: stored 270-938-3715 is Bright Sky's central/seasonal line (also Campspot's). The operator site gives Cave Creek's own number, (364) 203-1669; rec.gov gives the park attendant 270-879-4304. Suggest phone -> 364-203-1669 (keep 270-938-3715 second).
WEBSITE: add https://brightskycampgrounds.com/ beside the Campspot link (kept).

OPERATOR/OWNERSHIP: Campspot's legal name is 'Common-Cap, a Kentucky Limited Liability Company, d/b/a Cave Creek Campground' (Bright Sky Campgrounds), the same concessionaire as Pikes Ridge 1572. Kept federal (Corps campground under a concession), as for 1572.
